subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should direct `CronService.add` inputs be guaranteed implicit announce delivery for `current`, `session:*`, and command jobs, or should that policy remain solely in normalized public creation paths?
rationale: Current main already provides the requested default through gateway and CLI creation, so widening the service fallback changes an internal compatibility boundary that source inspection alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Keep normalization canonical
options.body: Leave the service helper narrow and add any missing regression coverage at the gateway, CLI, or agent-tool creation boundary.

options.title: Harden the service contract
options.body: Accept service-level defaulting only after inventorying direct callers and proving creation, persistence, execution, and single delivery for every newly affected shape.

recommendation.title: Keep normalization canonical
recommendation.body: Leave the service helper narrow and add any missing regression coverage at the gateway, CLI, or agent-tool creation boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged persistent-session restoration is the clearest recent product-contract decision for these targets.
